manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Records the live commons as signed frames via Playwright, grows in-between fidelity with EZsharpen, and emits an HTML LifePlayer scrubber.
manifest.name: @kody-w/commons_life_agent

action.description: life = record+grow+play (default); record = capture the life frames; grow = EZsharpen an existing recording; play = emit the LifePlayer for an existing recording.

dir.description: For grow/play: an existing recording dir to operate on.

duration.description: Total seconds of life to record (the lifespan window). Default 40.

interval.description: Seconds between recorded frames — the FRAME RESOLUTION (lower = higher fidelity). Default 4.

subdivide.description: EZsharpen: synthesize this many grown sub-frames between each pair for smoother playback. Default 3.

title.description: Optional player title. Default 'The Life of the Commons'.

url.description: Optional commons URL (default the live Pages site).
